title: Release-pinned peer reports and semantic-census controls
scope: Broaden current open-source peer comparison across DWG read, DWG write, DXF conversion, OBJECTS, and ACIS interpretation.
Separate released capability statements from issue reports and identify a low-cost differential protocol that avoids false semantic pass signals.
Refine existing plan gates without adding local findings, tests, fixtures, peer dependencies, or support claims.

sources.revision: Release v3.7.1, tag commit d7dc111; release page reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The tagged README presents separate DXF reader/writer and DWG reader/writer columns by AC code.
sources.limits: A version/direction table does not establish per-entity completeness, loss behavior, ACIS geometry semantics, or universal interoperability. Later master/issue reports are not automatically attributable to this release.

sources.revision: Open issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; report names ACadSharp 3.6.35.
sources.observed: Reporter describes silent loss of some AC1032 INSERT-family records across a read-to-DXF route using private AutoCAD inputs. A later commenter notes a possible count confound because TableEntity derives from Insert, while also distinguishing notification behavior in that commenter's own TABLE reproduction.
sources.limits: No public input or independently reproduced root cause is available in the issue. The inheritance observation is a test-method caveat, not a diagnosis of the original report.

sources.revision: Open issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; report names ACadSharp 3.6.51.
sources.observed: Reporter claims annotated LEADER TextWidth/TextHeight are zero immediately after DWG read and describes downstream DXF/render consequences with handle-matched comparison.
sources.limits: No public drawing or independent reproduction; report is an adversarial semantic-field probe only.

sources.project: ACadSharp issue #1184 and Autodesk field contract
sources.revision: Open issue page and Autodesk API reference reviewed 2026-10-20; report names ACadSharp 3.6.35 and 3.6.51.
sources.observed: Report describes a stored ShadePlotDPI/group-78 value passing through a validating setter, with zero meaningful only when shade resolution is not Custom; alleged read failures differ between DWG and DXF failsafe behavior.
sources.limits: Peer report is not a libdxfrw defect. Local generated tests already cover inactive zero versus active Custom and graph survival, so it does not justify duplicate tests.

sources.revision: Open issue page reviewed 2026-10-20; report names source commit 82f89217494e62ce0b02e9208572b4a708dd8c40 / ACadSharp 3.6.50.
sources.observed: Reporter describes an inverted optional LTYPE hard-pointer condition in the AC1014 DWG writer and claims independent ODA File Converter rejection.
sources.limits: This is a version- and writer-branch-specific peer report, not independent local execution or a claim about other AC versions.

sources.observed: Documentation limits ACIS goals to simple/known structures and polyhedral extraction, states arbitrary existing ACIS editing is not a goal, and states that ezdxf has no ACIS kernel; its browser can expose/export raw SAT/SAB data.
sources.limits: Raw inspection, simple body generation, or mesh extraction is not general ACIS B-rep validation, a geometry kernel result, or DWG AcDs association evidence.

sources.revision: Current issue and NEWS sources reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The issue reports a named modern AcDs-carried SAB loss route; NEWS describes incomplete/heuristic handling of AcDsPrototype_1b extraction.
sources.limits: Project and issue sources are advisory and do not qualify all LibreDWG versions or establish libdxfrw behavior.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: use exact release/commit, AC version, direction, source identity, typed inventory, and diagnostic capture for optional peer comparisons.
PAR-07/S8 and output gates: compare exact handles and concrete entity types by processing stage; do not use broad inheritance-family counts or same-codec reread alone as semantic evidence.
PlotSettings: reuse existing inactive-zero/active-Custom generated controls; no duplicate test lane.
ACIS: keep raw-carrier inspection, DWG/DataStorage association, neutral B-rep transfer, geometry-kernel validity, and native consumer acceptance separate.

planChanges: Added a release-pinned peer-report crosswalk spanning ACadSharp read/write and ezdxf/LibreDWG ACIS boundaries.
Specified exact-type/handle semantic inventories to avoid INSERT/TABLE subclass count confounds.
Specified stage-by-stage loss labels and preservation of diagnostics across parse, typed model, output, and independent reopen.
Retained fast local testing and milestone-only external reopens; peer unavailability is NOT_RUN and self-unblocks by continuing local items.
limitations: Issue reports are author-provided and not independently reproduced here; some inputs are private or absent.
No peer executable, third-party sample, native CAD application, or geometry kernel was used.
The research refines existing subplans only and does not resolve external/platform qualification or any J item.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
